title_en: The Mould That Changed the World

entries.sentence_en: In September 1928 Alexander Fleming, a bacteriologist at St Mary's Hospital, London, returned from holiday to find that a stray mould had contaminated a dish of staphylococcus bacteria.
entries.sentence_zh: 1928年9月，亚历山大·弗莱明，伦敦圣玛丽医院的细菌学家，度假归来，发现一团零星的/散落的霉菌污染了一只培养葡萄球菌这种细菌的培养皿。

entries.old_table_definition: 本文：玉米浆；短语. 玉米浆（浸泡玉米得到的副产品，可作微生物培养基）（corn-steep liquor was added to the medium）

entries.sentence_en: Fortune put the mould in Fleming's dish; tenacious teams and years of toil transformed it into a remedy.
